name: EAC (Erasing Attention Consistency)
authors_or_creators: Yuhang Zhang, Chengrui Wang, Xu Ling, Weihong Deng - Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT), Pattern Recognition and Intelligent System Laboratory
accuracy_fer2013: [uncertain] - FER2013 is not a primary benchmark in the EAC paper
accuracy_affectnet: 65.32% on AffectNet-7 and 64.55% / ~64% on AffectNet-8 (Overall / WAR), ResNet-18 backbone [uncertain on exact split]
accuracy_rafdb: 89.99% Overall on RAF-DB basic subset, ResNet-18 (clean-label setting); strong results also under 10/20/30% synthetic label-noise injections
pretrained_weights_available: yes - official GitHub repo provides training scripts; pretrained checkpoints for noisy-label settings on RAF-DB / AffectNet / FERPlus are released [uncertain on completeness]
inference_fps_or_latency: [uncertain] - not explicitly reported; comparable to a vanilla ResNet-18 forward pass since EAC adds no inference-time overhead
hardware_requirements: Training on a single NVIDIA GPU (e.g. RTX 2080 Ti / 3090 class); inference runs on commodity GPU or even CPU given the ResNet-18 backbone [uncertain]
loss_function: Combination of (1) standard cross-entropy classification loss, (2) flip attention consistency loss (KL/L2 between attention maps of an image and its horizontal flip), and (3) a CAM-erasing branch that randomly erases the most-attended region and enforces label consistency on the erased image to prevent overfitting to noisy labels
training_data_used: RAF-DB, AffectNet (7-class and 8-class), FERPlus; evaluated under both clean and synthetic noisy-label (10%/20%/30%) protocols
pretraining_strategy: supervised-pretrain - backbone initialized from MS-Celeb-1M face-recognition-pretrained weights (following the standard FER pipeline), with ImageNet weights also reported
input_modality: RGB image (plus its horizontal flip used during training for the attention-consistency branch)
cross_dataset_generalization: [uncertain] - paper focuses on intra-dataset clean and noisy-label evaluation; cross-dataset transfer not the main focus
robustness: Strong noisy-label robustness: outperforms prior noisy-label FER methods (SCN, RUL, DMUE) on RAF-DB, AffectNet, FERPlus under 10%/20%/30% synthetic label noise. Also robust on the real noisy WebEmotion / asymmetric-noise settings reported in the paper
explainability: Built around Class Activation Maps (CAMs) and attention visualization - the method explicitly produces and constrains attention maps, making attention behavior directly inspectable
deployment_target: server-GPU (also suitable for edge given the lightweight ResNet-18 backbone and zero inference-time overhead from the consistency mechanism)
